sentences.gloss: He is a man, she is a woman.
I am the teacher, you are the student.
She is a girl, he is a boy.
I’m here. (answering when someone calls you)
Excuse me, excuse me! (making your way through)
No, I am not a student.

sentences.text: 你好，我叫王明，我是学生。
sentences.gloss: Hello, my name is Wang Ming, I am a student.
alts: 你好，我是学生，我叫王明。

sentences.gloss: That person is not a teacher.

sentences.text: 这个女人是老师，那个男人是学生。
sentences.gloss: This woman is a teacher, that man is a student.
alts: 那个男人是学生，这个女人是老师。

sentences.gloss: This is Wang Ming, that is Anna.
Anna and Wang Ming are over there.
This is a flat, not a house.
This is the door, that is the window.
That is a wall, not a door.
The table and the chairs are over there.
This cupboard is not a wardrobe.
The pen and the paper are here.
This is a sheet of paper.
The plates and the cups are over there.
This is not a book, it is paper.
This is a room, not a flat.
